source_text: Quanta ante gesta! Mare transitum, manna, fontes, lex — et nusquam exaltatus Iesus. Ubi Iordanis transitur: In hac die incipio exaltare te. Neque enim ante mysterium baptismi exaltatur Iesus; baptizati in morte ipsius baptizantur, mors in crucis exaltatione completur. Exaltavit illum Deus et donavit nomen super omne nomen. Pars aquarum in mare salsum, pars dulcis permanet — baptizatorum varietas: qui ad saeculi salsum redeunt pereunt; qui munus Dei tenent dulcedinem servant. Unus Dominus, una fides, unum baptisma. Quando ad transitum Iordanis? Cum sacerdotes arcam portant et populus festinat — tunc Iesus exaltatur in conspectu populi. Cui gloria. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: How-many-things before done! Sea crossed, manna, springs, law — and nowhere exalted Jesus. Where Jordan is-crossed: In this day I-begin to-exalt you. Nor for before mystery of-baptism is-exalted Jesus; baptized-ones in death of-him are-baptized, death in of-cross exaltation is-completed. Exalted him God and gave name above every name. Part of-waters into sea salty, part sweet remains — of-baptized-ones variety: who unto of-age salty return perish; who gift of-God hold sweetness keep. One Lord, one faith, one baptism. When unto crossing of-Jordan? When priests ark carry and people hastens — then Jesus is-exalted in sight of-people. To-whom glory. Amen.
pass_b_english: How much came before! Red Sea crossed, manna given, springs opened, law given — and nowhere is Jesus said to be exalted. When the Jordan is crossed, God says: [[This day I begin to exalt you in the sight of the people >> Bible:Joshua 3:7]]. Jesus is not exalted before baptism’s mystery; [[all who are baptized into Christ Jesus are baptized into his death >> Bible:Romans 6:3]], and that death is completed in the cross’s lifting up. [[God exalted him and gave him the name above every name >> Bible:Philippians 2:9]]. Part of Jordan’s water runs to the salt sea, part stays sweet — a figure of the baptized: those who return to the world’s salt perish in bitter waves; those who keep God’s gift hold their sweetness. [[One Lord, one faith, one baptism >> Bible:Ephesians 4:5]]. When do we come to Jordan’s crossing? When priests bear the ark and the people hasten — then Jesus is exalted in the people’s sight. To him be glory. Amen.
